Ethereum sGYD holds GYD 0xe07F9D810a48ab5c3c914BA3cA53AF14E4491e8A. Assets and sGYD shares use 18-decimal base units, not USDC or dollars; redeem/withdraw return GYD, not the underlying diversified reserve collateral basket.

Deposit/mint pull caller GYD using allowance to sGYD and mint shares to receiver. Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; caller differing from owner needs existing share allowance. Receiver is explicit. No standalone prefunding, permit, authorization, distributor stream management or upgrades are admitted.

Deposit share output and redeem asset output round down; mint asset cost and withdraw share cost round up. Conversion includes one virtual asset and one virtual share (zero decimals offset). Small deposits can mint zero shares; these functions have no caller min-output/max-input/deadline guards and no explicit vault fee.

totalAssets is GYD balance minus un-emitted portions of finite reward streams. Pending streams are not immediately withdrawable entitlement; stream end dates are reward schedules, not a user lock. Reviewed ordinary exits have no cooldown, claim queue or separate claim call; balances, token behavior and configured dependencies can still revert.

Current official sGYD frontend terms explicitly prohibit users in the EU, UK, USA and selected other regions; the older docs list US/UK and selected jurisdictions. No eligibility was accepted or bypassed. Contract ERC4626 methods have no explicit KYC/whitelist modifier, which does not override legal restrictions.

sGYD uses an upgradeable UUPS implementation with administrator/distributor roles. Sourcify reports current implementation 0xceccF016083a0C943d572346193c549DAc592511; source evidence is not a fresh bytecode attestation or proof the implementation will persist. GYD backing/reserve composition and emissions can change; no yield or reserve-asset redemption promise.

sourceSemantics.collateralBasket: sGYD directly custodies GYD, not a caller-selected basket. GYD is a separate reserve-backed stablecoin. No GYD reserve mint/redemption, recovery, pool or collateral-vault method is admitted; no current reserve weight/value claim.
sourceSemantics.delays: No user redemption queue in reviewed source. Stream start/end are linear reward emission intervals; pending rewards are subtracted from totalAssets. UUPS administration may change implementation.

lifecycleEvidence.method: Current rendered official product route, browser snapshot; no wallet connected, terms accepted, transaction or region bypass
lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: sGYD | Gyroscope; Ethereum; Terms and Conditions - sGYD. This web application is provided as a tool for users to interact with the Gyroscope Protocol on their own initiative. Due to regulatory restrictions, this functionality is not accessible to users in the EU, the UK, the USA, and selected other regions.
lifecycleEvidence.conclusion: Current official sGYD product route remains offered behind explicit legal terms; restriction is eligibility, not a retirement or exit-only announcement.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: sGYD is the yield-bearing version of the GYD stablecoin ... GYD can be deposited into / withdrawn from sGYD at any time ... Users can interact with sGYD either directly on-chain through the ERC4626 functions or through a frontend ... subject to the applicable restrictions and Terms of Service.
lifecycleEvidence.conclusion: Product/mechanism evidence supplementary to current official app route; not treated as alone establishing current lifecycle.

limitations: No RPC transaction, simulation, successful execution or runtime bytecode comparison was performed. Source-provider match status is recorded literally, not upgraded to a runtime attestation.
Only Ethereum chain 1 and the named target are admitted; other chains, reserve collateral contracts, RSR staking, distributors and routers receive no capabilities.

All callable function ABI entries receive selected/excluded decisions including views; constructors, events, errors, fallback and receive are retained as ABI evidence but are not function capabilities.
Original deployment ABIs are preserved. Both implementation ABIs already use stateMutability without redundant legacy constant/payable function flags; catalog fragments preserve that mutability.
